laws.rule: It is illegal to enter or exit Cyprus through any air or seaport in the north: this includes Tymbou (Ercan) and Lefkoniko (Gecitkale) airports and the seaports of Kyrenia (Girne) and Famagusta (Gazi Magusa). Travel between north and south is permitted only at formal crossing points in the UN Buffer Zone, for people who arrived through legal ports in the south. Some other countries may refuse entry if your passport or luggage shows entry through the north.
